summary: Added the ratelimit stage (client address resolution, limit selection, all-or-nothing charging, headers, rl_refused summary) and fixed existing bugs (float arithmetic in token refill, Unicode digits in `per`). One existing test (tests/test_ratelimit.py test_token_bucket) still fails because it expects a summary key `limited`, which contradicts the spec's `rl_refused`; tests could not be changed.
